## BruFin 0.6 — private server sync

### Host BruFin at home

- Run BruFin's web dashboard and SQLite API together on a homelab with Docker Compose or Portainer.
- Keep the server database in a persistent Docker volume, separate from the app installation.
- Set up a fresh server from its browser without manually retrieving the API token. This one-time first claim is enabled for the private LAN/VPN setup and can be disabled for environments where the server is reachable by untrusted people.
- Pair Android devices by scanning a short-lived, single-use QR shown by the server dashboard. The QR does not contain the permanent API token.

### Use BruFin on every device

- Choose demo data, a standalone local database, or a self-hosted server from the startup screen.
- Keep a local working copy on each client. Changes sync when the server is available and remain queued while offline.
- Review conflicting edits instead of silently losing one device's changes.
- Keep using BruFin standalone; no server or cloud account is required for local-only use.

### Android release

- This version is signed with BruFin's stable release key and can update v0.5 in place.
